description:
Validate and persist a selection over this account's own corpus, and size it. Returns a selection_id and the eligible-lead count.

THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE A FILTER IS ACCEPTED. The submit that follows carries the id alone — which is exactly what keeps a predicate that could name another tenant's data off the spending path.

Two shapes:
- source_kind='corpus_query' + filter: an arbitrary filter AST (author it from list_bulk_corpus_fields).
- source_kind='unenriched_run' + campaign_id or job_id: a past run. The provenance IS the selection; no filter needed.

Creating a selection SPENDS NOTHING and QUEUES NOTHING. It is a validated, sized, re-usable handle. A refusal here is always client-fixable and always names the offending field — an unknown field key, an operator the field's type does not allow, a value on a valueless operator, a list over 100, a tree over depth 3.

The eligible_leads it returns is Gate 2's number: leads that would actually GAIN from the requested stages. That is the figure to confirm with the user before submitting, because it is the one the run is sized against.

campaign_id.description: The past campaign to re-enrich. REQUIRED for 'unenriched_run' unless job_id is given.

exclude_without_website.description: Exclude leads with no website at all — a site crawl cannot help them. Defaults to true.

filter.description: The filter AST — a TREE, never a string. A group is {op:'and'|'or', conditions:[…]}; a condition is {field, operator, value}. `field` MUST be a key from list_bulk_corpus_fields and `operator` one that field's own `operators` list allows — anything else is a 422 naming what was wrong. Call list_bulk_corpus_fields FIRST; do not guess field names. Only meaningful for source_kind='corpus_query'.

job_id.description: ONE job (one location) inside a campaign — the natural split when a whole campaign would exceed the record ceiling.

source_kind.description: 'corpus_query' (pair with `filter`) or 'unenriched_run' (pair with campaign_id or job_id).

stages.description: Stages the NEW run would enable: 'spidersite' (crawl the website), 'spiderverify' (verify emails), 'vayapin' (publish a PERMANENT public profile page). Eligibility is scoped to THIS set — a lead missing only VayaPin is still eligible for a VayaPin-only run. At least one stage must leave a trace in the corpus.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: create_bulk_selection
